summary: Iteration 9, frontend only. Tested the server build /js/toolbar.min.js on / and /test-modal.html, at desktop 1920x1080 and in a Pixel 5 touch context, with speechSynthesis mocked. PASS 1, per-link adaptive colours: each link now carries --cplus-link-color, --cplus-link-visited-color and --cplus-link-pointed-color, plus the class cplus-link-adaptive. The style tag only maps :link, :visited and :hover/:focus/:active to these variables. Ratios against each link's real blended background follow. Home with darkblue_orange_brown alone, and the same with reinforcedContrasts: orange CTAs 'Télécharger le .xpi' and '.xpi Android' on rgb(255,121,0) have link darkblue 5.82, visited rgb(104,26,26) 4.56 (was 2.69) and hover rgb(76,49,0) 4.57 (was 1.93). The peach banner link on rgb(255,242,230) has link 13.91, visited brown 6.44 and hover rgb(153,99,0) 4.61. White-background links have 15.3, 7.08 and 5.07. Dark header and footer links on rgb(13,13,13) have rgb(114,114,255) 5.15, rgb(214,95,95) 5.24 and orange 9.84. On test-modal, #dark-link on #111 has 5.01, visited rgb(214,95,95) 5.09 (was 4.31) and hover orange 9.56. ivory_black + darkblue_orange_brown: 5.57, 4.79, 10.63. black_ivory + lightblue_orange_lightgreen: 4.56, 4.80, 5.03. black_green + yellow_orange_blue: 4.78, 5.14, 4.79. All 11 links on home and all links on test-modal are >= 4.5 in all 3 states for every combination. Dynamic links added later get the variables too: orange 5.82/4.56/4.57, and rgba(0,0,0,.6) over the page 5.13/5.03/4.65. PASS 2, reset: noModifications for both, in either order, removes all classes, all 3 custom properties (no style attribute left) and the adaptive style tag. PASS 3, settings bug: 15 full cycles (change mode, pick mode, validate, settings, enter edit-color-read, exit, multi-click on Read in colors, back, reload) gave 0 pageerrors. data-values starts with 'noModifications,' and the labels are coherent ('Current value: “no modification” 1/3 — switch to “Separated syllables for hovered word” 2/3', and so on). PASS 4, non-regressions: (a) tap/empty tap: tap t1 gives on/1, empty tap gives suspended, re-tap gives on/2; ended, then empty, then re-tap gives on/3. (b) Masks: desktop 500/500 and touch 324/324, pointer-events none, elementFromPoint gives #dialog-ok, #cp filled and #dialog-ok clicked or tapped, the band moves on pointermove and on tap, reset removes the masks. (c) i18n first visit shows 'Unfold Comfort+' with no pageerror. (d) Tooltips: desktop 'Click to vocalize, press Esc or right_click to stop.', mobile 'Tap to vocalize, tap an empty area to stop, tap again to activate'. (e) Click, re-click and other text; Esc; right click; Tab focus reads; Enter on the link being read goes to #ancre; the sentence with a link is read in full; link 1st click reads with no navigation, 2nd activates; accordion 1st tap reads and focuses with 0 toggles, 2nd toggles; button 0 then 1. (f) Palette opens in 1 click with 0 utterances. (g) Text reinforcement: #aaa becomes #000, #ff9966 becomes rgb(204,68,0), #555 on #222 becomes #fff, #777 on rgba(0,0,0,.85) becomes #fff, body background unchanged, exact restore. ONE REMAINING ISSUE, during a real mouse hover only: the page's own hover:bg-confort-orange-dark changes the CTA background to rgb(217,101,0) on hover. The pointed colour rgb(76,49,0) was computed against the non-hover rgb(255,121,0), so the real hover contrast is 3.33:1 (measured with page.hover).

ui_bugs.issue: The pointed (:hover) colour is computed against the link's resting background. If the page changes the link's own background on hover (homepage CTAs: hover:bg-confort-orange-dark, rgb(255,121,0) becomes rgb(217,101,0)), the real hover contrast is rgb(76,49,0) on rgb(217,101,0) = 3.33:1, below 4.5. Measured with a real mouse hover on both 'Télécharger le .xpi Android' and 'Télécharger le .xpi', with darkblue_orange_brown alone and with reinforcedContrasts. :focus is fine (4.57) because the background does not change on focus. Possible fix: compute the pointed colour so it passes against both the resting background and a darker or lighter version of it (for example target ~5.5:1, or check rgb(bg*0.85)). Or recompute on pointerenter/focusin by reading the background while :hover applies, then set --cplus-link-pointed-color.

design_issues.screen: Links on mid-tone or semi-transparent dark backgrounds (rgba(0,0,0,.6), black_green)
issues: Once the colours are forced to >= 4.5, the three states become almost the same colour: rgb(241,241,255), rgb(250,237,237) and rgb(255,228,179) on grey 102; white and rgb(255,246,229) on green. On the orange CTA, visited rgb(104,26,26) and hover rgb(76,49,0) are both near-black. The states cannot be told apart by colour, so consider a non-colour cue (underline thickness or style) for :visited and :hover.

action_items: LOW: the orange CTA hover is 3.33:1 because the page's hover:bg-confort-orange-dark darkens the background while the pointed colour was computed against the resting background. Add a safety margin, or recompute the pointed colour against the hovered background.
LOW (design): add a non-colour cue between the link, visited and hover states on backgrounds where the adapted colours converge.
critical_code_review_comments: color-contrast.service.ts: the paletteCache key is the rounded background only; it must also be invalidated whenever linkPalette changes. refreshAdaptiveLinks clears it, which is correct, but any other path that mutates linkPalette must clear it too.
applyAdaptiveLinkColor pushes the link into adaptiveLinks again every time it is re-applied (for example by the MutationObserver), so the array can hold duplicates. Use a Set.

If adjustColorForBackground returns '' (palette entry noModifications), the custom property is not set. The CSS var() then has no fallback and the colour becomes 'inherit'-like. Add a fallback, for example var(--cplus-link-color, currentColor).
updated_files: /app/tests/links_probe9.js (new test helper only, no source modified)

success_rate.frontend: 97% (all requested checks pass; 1 low-priority real-hover case on CTAs whose background changes on hover)

context_for_next_testing_agent: links_probe9.js (page.evaluate(probe, optionalSelector)) reads the per-link custom properties and gives the ratio of each state against the composited background, along with the min per state. Themes call linkStyleServiceInstance.setLinkStyle(theme.link): to test a theme + palette pair, call setColorsContrasts FIRST and then setLinkStyle. The read-aloud service passes a gesture through to the page for 1 s after a vocalization ends on the same element (by design), so wait more than 1.2 s between independent vocalization checks. Calling setReadAloud right after load, before i18n is ready, gives an empty tooltip (a test artifact; after a ~3 s wait or with the toolbar open the text is correct). After a reload the toolbar stays open, so use JS clicks in the shadowRoot (#confort, #change-mode-btn, radio #<mode>, 'Validate this mode', #settings-btn, the edit button inside app-color-read, #prev-toolbar).
rca of the issue: The real-hover CTA case: pointedColor = adjust(palette.orange, getBlendedBackground(link)) is evaluated with no :hover applied. The site's Tailwind hover class swaps the background (rgb(255,121,0) to rgb(217,101,0), about 0.73x luminance). The 4.57:1 colour therefore drops to 3.33:1 while hovered.
